anthropic.title: Anthropic API
anthropic.hint: Direct Anthropic API billing; use the full Claude model id.

openai.title: OpenAI API
openai.hint: Direct OpenAI API billing through the local Responses adapter; use an OpenAI model id supporting function calling.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.hint: the model id as OpenRouter lists it, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5; add [1m] for a 1M context

deepseek.title: DeepSeek
deepseek.hint: e.g. deepseek-chat; add [1m] when the model has a 1M context

custom.title: Custom (Anthropic-compatible)
custom.hint: any Anthropic-compatible endpoint; its base URL is set per model
